cohort: Pregnant women attending a Tertiary Health Facility, screened for gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Compared to a control group, the group with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) had worse maternal and fetal outcomes, including higher rates of polyhydramnios, recurrent vaginal infections, caesarean section, metabolic problems, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Among the GDM group, the rate of caesarean section was increased.
